name: Notification bell
author: WinDock
description: A scriptable bell that behaves like the notification centre: the unread count in a badge and a click that opens WinDock's notification centre. Settings turn it into a plain button that opens Windows' notification centre (Win+N) with a fixed badge number, a badge colour or your own image.

settings.label: Show the unread count
settings.description: Reads Windows' notifications (WinDock polls the notification list every few seconds). Off: nothing polls and the fixed number below shows.

settings.label: Fixed badge (0: none)
settings.description: Shown while the unread count is off.

settings.label: Image instead of the bell
settings.description: A file of the widget (after exporting it) or the full path of any file, whose shell icon is drawn.
